component.name: Rigcore
component.summary: Centro de control para portátiles gaming

description.p: Rigcore brings temperatures, fans, performance modes, battery charging and keyboard lighting together in one app, using the standard Linux kernel interfaces instead of a driver per model.

ul.li: CPU and GPU temperatures (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel), usage, power and history
Quiet, Balanced and Performance modes through power-profiles-daemon or tuned
Fan boost and temperature curves, battery charge limit and persistent lighting with the optional Rigcore hardware service
Keyboard lighting for Alienware, ASUS, Lenovo Legion, Acer and standard RGB keyboards

description.p: Game profiles are not available in the Flatpak edition, because the sandbox cannot see running games; use the AppImage or a distribution package for them.
New name: Rigcore (formerly Vórtice), with a new icon. Settings are migrated automatically.
